narrative.thesis: United States is profiled through long-run World Bank indicators covering the economy, population, health, work, technology, and environment. Scale, innovation, immigration, and a resilient consumer economy.
insights: Population has moved up since 2000, giving the report a clear demographic baseline.
Life expectancy is higher than in 2000, showing the direction of health and longevity conditions.
Recent GDP growth averages 3.3% across the latest 5 available observations.
Low fertility is a central long-term pressure in the projection scenarios.
narrative.projectionNote: 2035 scenarios are simple educational trend projections from recent historical observations. They are not official forecasts.
